answer: A bond of 23% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in island, and jade reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 75 aliases, and each one needs its own funded basalt account. A farm of 1059 identities would post 2648 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
